span.p:
(( Cassandra ))
Keyspace: evcache
RF=3, CL=QUORUM
Writes to commit log
and memtable

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Key insight: Netflix uses write-through for user-specific state
(playback position, viewing history) where consistency matters.
The cache reduces read latency from ~10ms (Cassandra) to ~1ms.
